title: 对: to, towards
summary: Lets you say who an attitude or action is aimed at, as in 他对我很好.
structure: A + 对 + B + 很 + Adjective
A + 对 + B + Verb (说, 笑)
explanation:
对 + person goes before an adjective or verb to say who it is aimed at: 他对我很好 'He's good to me', 老师对学生说 'The teacher says to the students.' Like other such words, the 对 part comes BEFORE the verb or adjective.

Don't confuse it with 对 'correct' (你说得对 'You're right') or 对不起 'sorry': the position tells you which one it is.

examples.zh: 老师对我们说：'明天考试。'
examples.en: The teacher said to us: 'There's a test tomorrow.'
Exercise is good for the body.

mistakes.why: 对 + person goes before the adjective.
对 + person comes before 说.

exercises.en: My grandma is very kind to me.
why: Correct: A 对 B 很好 = A is good to B.

exercises.prompt: Which means 'Running is good for your health'?
why: Correct: 对 + 身体 before 很好.
对 can't go after the adjective.
This would mean 'for running, the body is good'.

exercises.instruction: Say who he said it to: 妈妈.
why: Correct: 对 + person before 说.
对妈妈 can't sit between 说了 and what was said.
对 can't go at the end.

exercises.prompt: In which sentence does 对 mean 'to / towards'?
why: Correct: 对 + person before 很好.
给 + person + 说 isn't the usual way to say 'say to'.
